reviews.title: LOVE this game but FIX THIS!!!!
reviews.text: This has become my obsession since first discovering it on Apple Arcade and it’s a FANTASTIC game! BUT the newest update with The Buzz feature has now made it so the “continue boards” button has disappeared when playing archives. The button has been replaced by “play sprints” so in order to continue playing the game you’re playing from a date, or even play the Daily Double, you have to hit “archives” and then go back into the date. It’s really frustrating and inefficient! Please fix this!! Also maybe it’s because not a ton of folks have played The Buzz archives yet, but the ranking system is clearly malfunctioning. My overall score increased but my overall ranking went up? Isn’t the goal to have a smaller number rank and climb to number one?

reviews.title: Fun, but still needs improvements
reviews.text:
I love Jeopardy, and I’ve loved it my whole life. I’m so glad there’s finally a great daily game for it. 

The three daily categories are, in my opinion, the perfect amount for a daily wake up, or a nightly wind down.

While I’ve only had it for a few weeks, the difficulty of the questions don’t always seem to align with the points, and based on the statistics they provide for each clue (which is awesome by the way), could use some improvement.

Additionally, I love typing out my answers, but find that, often times, the correct answer will appear as the first choice, even if I only type a generic part of it. For example, if the answer is “the Black Sea,” as long as I type out “Sea,” the correct answer will almost certainly appear first. It sort of takes a little fun out of it.

Really love what the development team has created though, and I’m sure there will be many updates and improvements to come.

reviews.title: lost weekly leaderboard counter
reviews.text:
A recent update got rid of the cool animated display showing your place on the weekly leaderboard. I don’t know why they got rid of it, but it was actually a very fun thing to see, and inspired me play more frequently. 

Now your place on the weekly leaderboard is relegated to a very tiny little non-animated bit of text. So boring.

reviews.title: One obvious missing feature
reviews.text: This is a great way to get a little daily jeopardy fix, and I really appreciate how responsive the dev team is - I can tell that they’ve fixed issues I had when I first started playing. The one thing I’d love that seems obvious but is missing is a way to see old categories/answers once you’ve already completed them. Sometimes I want to test my friends, sometimes I’m curious what a day I forgot about had, sometimes I just fumbled my phone and skipped something and want to see what it was. Would love to see that added!

reviews.title: Jeopardy is great, but not like this
reviews.text:
I love Jeopardy, and the app is so close to being great. It’s smooth, the clues are perfect. I like to be competitive, though, and the fact that you’re competing against folks using multiple choice feels frustrating. I do love being able to enter the answers myself, but I deeply dislike how as soon as you start typing, the app suggests three answers. It makes it super easy to cheat because often, the correct answer (or question) is listed in the suggestions after typing in one letter.

Also, I’d love to be able to skip some of the slower parts of the app like calculating the score.
